answer: An agent delivering ivory roses from a meadow to a harbor must not erase a bad record by reopening under a new name. Give every unknown seller zero unsecured credit: buyers release funds only after verified delivery, or require collateral covering the full advance. A new alias therefore returns the seller to the strict starting terms instead of restoring trusted status. Any relaxed terms must be earned through independently checked deliveries. This reduces the payoff from reputation resets, but depends on reliable delivery checks and does not identify common ownership.
